_readme: Bibliography for the IPI paper. Keys match the [CITE-key] placeholders in
drafts/sections/*.md. Consumed by code/35-bibliography.py, which validates that
every placeholder resolves and emits drafts/sections/references.md.
The 'status' field is deliberate and must not be removed:
verified   - checked against the source or a primary listing (some during the
confident  - canonical work the author can state from knowledge; venue/year
believed correct but page numbers may need a final check
UNVERIFIED - could not be confirmed. DO NOT SUBMIT with any of these
outstanding: either verify, replace, or cut the claim it supports.
